name: Leah
description: Moved to the valley to make art in her forest cottage. Foraged salads, goat cheese, and wild mushrooms win her over.

seo.title: Leah — Sculptor
seo.description: Moved to the valley to make art in her forest cottage. Foraged salads, goat cheese, and wild mushrooms win her over.

stardew.intro: The valley's sculptor, living in a cabin north of town. Grounded, nature-loving, and happiest with mud on her hands.

heartEvents.title: Forest foraging
heartEvents.summary: Meet her foraging in the woods — she talks about leaving the city for art.

heartEvents.title: Saloon art show
heartEvents.summary: She displays sculptures at the saloon; show up to support her.

heartEvents.title: Ex arrives
heartEvents.summary: Her old partner Kel shows up uninvited — your response shapes the scene.

heartEvents.title: Sculpture invite
heartEvents.summary: She asks you to model for a piece she is carving in the rain.

heartEvents.title: Cottage kiss
heartEvents.summary: Inside her cottage after finishing a sculpture, she kisses you.

relationships.name: Elliott
relationships.note: Fellow creative on the beach — mutual respect for each other's work.

relationships.name: Evelyn
relationships.note: Sometimes visits George and Evelyn; gentle intergenerational friendship.

trivia: Salad uses foraged greens from Spring — easy to gift before Winter 23 if you pick dandelions and leeks.
